scenes.title: The Last Collection
scenes.narration: Jo reached the weather station along its maintained service track. The building would close the next day, and Nico, its retired observer, had asked her to collect the last mail from the porch postbox. He had lent her its key. Inside, she found one sealed packet with his name on it. She placed it in her canvas mail bag. Returning it seemed a small task, but she knew how much this final connection to the station mattered to him.
scenes.prompt: Why was collecting the packet important beyond the delivery itself?

options.text: It would allow Jo to become the new weather observer
It was Nico's final connection to the closing station
It proved that the station would remain open indefinitely

scenes.explanation: The station is closing, and the last mail matters to Nico as a final connection to his former workplace.

scenes.title: The Route on the Wall
scenes.narration: In the unlocked workroom, Jo studied a route map before descending. An old timetable marked the village cooperative as the mail collection point. A recent note added Nico's farm beside the hillside path. Both signed paths were maintained and open. The forest route would bring her to people who had worked with him; the hillside route would let her hand over the packet directly. Jo checked the sealed envelope once more, then folded the current route sheet into her pocket.
scenes.prompt: What was the main advantage of the hillside route?

options.text: Jo could avoid using an open, maintained path
Jo could leave the packet in the station workroom
Jo could give the packet directly to Nico

scenes.explanation: The hillside route ends beside Nico's farm, allowing Jo to hand the packet to him directly.

scenes.title: Different Ways to Return
scenes.narration: At the path junction, Jo met a cooperative worker who was returning through the forest. The worker remembered sharing meals with Nico during winter supply runs. She offered to carry news of the station's closure back to the village. The hillside path remained clear, leading towards the roof of Nico's farmhouse below. Jo could reconnect the packet with its wider community first, or preserve the quiet of a personal delivery. She did not need to open it to choose.
scenes.prompt: What information could the cooperative worker bring to the village?

options.text: News that the weather station was closing
The private contents of Nico's sealed packet
A promise that Nico was returning to work

scenes.explanation: The worker offers to take news of the closure to the village. The packet stays sealed.

transitions.label: Take the forest path to the village cooperative
Take the hillside path to Nico's farm

scenes.title: A Table in the Village
scenes.narration: Jo followed the worker to the cooperative. They contacted Nico, who came down from his farm to collect the sealed packet. Around the familiar kitchen table, he opened it: former colleagues had sent photographs from his years at the station. The visit became an afternoon of shared memories. Jo left the borrowed key with him and walked home. Her route had taken longer, but it had returned a piece of the mountain to the village as well as to its keeper.

options.text: The packet was opened before Nico arrived
Nico shared the photographs and memories with other people
Jo kept Nico's borrowed key as a souvenir

scenes.explanation: Nico opens the packet at the cooperative, and the visit becomes an afternoon of shared memories.

scenes.title: The Last Letter at Home
scenes.narration: Jo followed the hillside path to the farm and gave Nico the sealed packet with his key. He opened it beside the kitchen window. Former colleagues had sent photographs of the station and a short letter thanking him for keeping its door open to travellers. Nico chose one photograph for the wall and put the others away carefully. Jo stayed for tea, then left him with his own memories. The station could close without taking every part of his work away.
scenes.prompt: Why did the personal delivery suit this ending?

options.text: It let Jo decide which private photographs Nico should keep
It required Nico to return the packet without opening it
It gave Nico space to receive and choose his memories quietly

scenes.explanation: At home, Nico can choose a photograph and receive the memories in a quiet personal visit.

authoringNotes.brief: Uma voluntária recolhe a última correspondência de uma estação de montanha e decide como devolvê-la a quem a escreveu.

visualContinuity.characters: Jo, a 44-year-old woman with a broad face, freckled brown skin, dark eyes, short curly brown hair, a mustard waterproof jacket, dark hiking trousers and well-used walking boots. Nico is a retired weather observer in his late sixties, with grey hair, a lined face and a plain navy fleece. The cooperative worker is a 38-year-old woman with a square face, short black hair, a maroon fleece and dark walking trousers; her appearance remains the same at the path junction and the cooperative kitchen.
visualContinuity.locations: An old mountain weather station reached by a maintained service track: porch with a locked postbox, workroom with a route map, and two signed descent paths. The forest path ends at the village cooperative; the hillside path ends beside Nico's farm. Both paths are maintained and open.
visualContinuity.clues: Jo has Nico's postbox key and a small canvas mail bag. The last sealed packet is addressed to Nico. An old timetable on the map marks the former village collection point, while a current note marks his farm. The packet remains sealed until Nico receives it.

authoringNotes.learningFocus: Inferência de motivação, comparação de rotas e consequências sociais sem resposta narrativa certa.
authoringNotes.proposedAudience: Adultos aprendendo inglês; sem violência gráfica. Faixa etária não é um recurso implementado no site.
authoringNotes.reviewStatus: Produção e envio à VPS concluídos: WAVs gerados a partir do texto exato e conferidos por transcrição automática; artes 2D dark inspecionadas e corrigidas por cena. Grafo e questões verificados pelos testes. Não declara revisão auditiva humana nem certificação CEFR.
authoringNotes.supportedGameplay: Cenas, narração pré-gravada, uma pergunta por cena, uma bifurcação e dois finais. Objetos, tecnologias e ações são elementos da ficção; não requerem inventário, fala do jogador, combate ou novos eventos de gameplay.
authoringNotes.levelNote: Nível e tamanho são propostas editoriais, não certificação automática CEFR.
humanReviewChecklist: Revisar compreensão e naturalidade do inglês no nível indicado.
Revisar se cada pergunta tem exatamente uma resposta apoiada no texto.
Revisar continuidade, motivação, tom e ambos os finais.
Revisar o registro de autoria e autorização do texto; preencher créditos e evidências das mídias que forem produzidas.
Produzir e escutar WAVs a partir de audioText; revisar e produzir as imagens-base e loops.
Importar como rascunho, validar mídia no servidor e publicar somente após revisão.

visualStyle.description: Animação 2D cinematográfica dark: personagens adultos desenhados, contornos limpos, cel shading, cenários pintados, paleta contida e sombras profundas com pistas legíveis. Terror com tensão sombria; sem pessoas fotorrealistas.
